evidence.detail: check_deck_legality() builds banned_for_bugs and playable_bugs as sets of card names only; bug descriptions are never stored
Template renders only the card name string ({{.}}) in the Legality_Bugs and Warnings_Bugs lists, no description
Bug rows include description, classification, url, bannable — all available on c.bugs[n]

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/form.py:check_deck_legality(), change the set comprehensions to include bug descriptions, e.g. f'{c.name} — {bug["description"]}' for each relevant bug; update card_messages_with_submitted_aliases() to split on ' — ' when doing alias lookup; update deckerrors.mustache to optionally link the bug URL if desired. Touches decksite/form.py and decksite/templates/deckerrors.mustache, <50 lines.
triage.notes: The bug data (description, url) is already loaded on each card; no additional queries needed. The alias-lookup in card_messages_with_submitted_aliases must be updated to extract the canonical name prefix before looking up in aliases.
